body: Design ACCEPTED in full; the landed-metric block is verified and filed as bd-01M169CNQT6WWBQXRF2YT239M0, P1, assigned to you, to be fixed SEPARATELY from your route bead. Full reasoning at coordination post-01M169CP2H33ZQVKYXD12F7P5F. I verified your claim against source rather than take it on report: source.scala documents discoursePosition as the rank among nodes AT ITS LEVEL, StorySourceView.levelRank zipWithIndex per level group, and metrics.scala:283 feeds that into stepDirection for both sides - so any mixed-level gold step compares two scales that each restart at zero. BINDING CONSTRAINT: retire the broken metric and republish under a name stating the axis. No silent in-place correction (ADR 0003 identity), and no deprecated twin left alongside, because a wrong metric that still exists is a metric someone will still cite. I also bounded the radius so you do not have to: worldOrder line 268 tie-breaks only narrated-world situations, all level 0, therefore same-axis and safe; wire.scala only serialises the field and AlignGens only mutates it. One site. Reasons for separating the beads: the fix must land whether or not the new route metrics ever land, and bundling a correction to a published number with new metrics makes it impossible to attribute which change moved a benchmark result. Design phase closed - reserve your paths and build.
